news.aiSummary: PyTorch Dynamo previously attempted to inline the body of torch.overrides.handle_torch_function, which caused failures due to direct interaction with the C mode stack. The implementation has been updated to treat this function as a TorchInGraphFunctionVariable, allowing its handler to forward to dispatch correctly.
